newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty flat in live trade, short term depos down.
newsitem.headline: Zloty flat in live trade, short term depos down.

text.p: The Polish zloty closed flat against the basket of currencies in live, balanced trade as the currency selling trend was offset by foreign sales of Polish T-bills, dealers said.
They said the currency selling was caused by the dollar's slip on international markets against the mark on profit taking after it rallied on the back of U.S. election results.
"Zloty trade was balanced as two opposite trends existed, with selling dominating in the afternoon after an early buying trend," said Pawel Gajewski from Creditanstalt SA.
